purpose: Competing epileptogenic-zone (EZ) and propagation hypotheses for blinded Wang virtual Patient 2 (test case), drafted from the P2 SEEG (P2_SEEG_ts_fit.npz) mapped through the P2 gain, and from the preliminary MAP ensemble of the frozen T0011 model. No ground truth, vault item, reserved notebook or study-001 file was accessed.

hypotheses.label: Left dorsolateral prefrontal EZ: Left-F2-rostral (region idx 7) and/or Left-F2-caudal (8), propagation to Left-Middle-frontal-sulcus (9), Left-SFS-rostral (10)
hypotheses.basis: Largest ictal (3.75-5.5 s) vs pre-stimulation (0.25-0.5 s) high-pass log-power rises are on I'13-14 (+14.1), I'14-15 (+13.2), OR'13-14 (+12.9), I'12-13 (+12.5); top-gain region of the I' contacts is Left-F2-caudal (8), of OR'13-14 Left-F2-rostral (7). Largest slow (DC-like) ictal shifts: OR'10-11 (-0.30; top gain Left-MFS 9, then 7), PM'6-7 / PM'5-6 (top gain 7 / 10). Frozen-model MAP: region 7 has the highest mean x0 over 24 starts in the sensitivity window and is 2nd in the primary window.

hypotheses.label: Orbitofrontal / mesial prefrontal EZ: Right-Orbito-frontal-cortex (82), Left-Orbito-frontal-cortex (1), Right-Gyrus-rectus (83), Left/Right-F1-mesial-prefrontal (12/93), anterior cingulate (27/108)
hypotheses.basis: Model-derived: region 82 has the highest MAP x0 in all 24 primary-window starts (x0 -2.28, sub-threshold) and is rank 1 in 50% of sensitivity-window starts; PM'1-2 slow shift (+0.095; top gain 12, then 93, 108). Caveat: region 82 carries the largest gain in the implant (R7-8 88.2, R8-9 69.3), so a small x0 change moves those channels strongly; its ranking may reflect gain leverage rather than ictal involvement.

hypotheses.label: Left mesial temporal EZ: Left-Amygdala (74) with insula (33)
hypotheses.basis: B'2-3 (+9.1) and A'4-5 (+8.9) high-pass log-power rises (top gain Left-Amygdala 74); not supported by the MAP fits (74 not in the top 12 of either window).

hypotheses.label: Stimulation-dependent / network-emergent seizure without a supra-threshold autonomous node
hypotheses.basis: The seizure-like epoch starts ~36 ms after the end of the 50 Hz stimulation train (A0010), so the stimulated tissue may be transiently, not intrinsically, epileptogenic. Primary-window MAP ensemble: no region with x0 > -2.06 at any of 24 starts.

source_evidence.signals: data/wang-5367ef4/data/dataSim/Patient2/P2_SEEG_ts_fit.npz (sha256 fe5a83ac..., 191 bipolar channels, 125 Hz from time_steps): raw high-pass (10 Hz) power by epoch and slow-shift (raw minus 0.25-0.5 s mean) by epoch, computed in work/T0014/explore*.py; fitted features via the frozen features.compute_feature
source_evidence.anatomy: P2 SC and gain from the same npz (A0009); region order = VepMrtrixLut 1..162 (to_verify per A0010)
source_evidence.imaging: reported_absent (A0009: no MRI, no contact coordinates)
source_evidence.seeg_markings: not_applicable (virtual patient, no clinical markings); epochs from A0009/A0010 (stimulation 504-3504 ms, seizure-like ~3540-7400 ms)
source_evidence.model_fit: preliminary MAP ensemble (24 L-BFGS starts per window) of the frozen T0011 model, see the T0014 MAP ModelBundle

priors.x0: N(-2.5, 0.5) per region (frozen model); isolated-node bifurcation x0 = -2.06
priors.other: frozen T0011 priors (z_init at softmin-capped equilibrium + 0.2 N(0,1); K lognormal(0,1); tau0 lognormal(log 10, 0.6); amp, u, sigma data-centred; phi uniform(-1,1))

unobserved_node_assumptions: Only 4 of 162 regions have any contact with gain > 25% of the implant maximum; most regions are constrained only by network dynamics and the x0 prior and their x0 is not interpreted. Subcortical/cerebellar nodes kept with P2 SC weights. The 2D inversion model has no stimulus input, so stimulation-driven activity is either excluded (primary window) or must be absorbed as region activity (sensitivity window).
discrimination_checks: H1 vs H2: NUTS posterior P(x0 > -2.06) and P(rank 1) for regions 7, 8 vs 82, 1, 83; robustness of ranking across the two prespecified windows
H2 gain-leverage check: whether region 82's x0 is driven by R7-8/R8-9 alone (posterior predictive residuals on those channels)
H4: P(no region > -2.06) under the posterior; and fitted 'seizing' indicator (max x > -1 within the window)
Multimodality: EZ ranking at each of 24 L-BFGS optima; R-hat across 16 chains started from distinct optima
